name: Alyssa
storyline: Welcome to a dark world you've found yourself in against your will. As you wander through the terrifying mansion, your perception of reality will change, and your soul will be shattered... With only a fragile lighter in her hand, Alyssa must face ferocious beasts hidden beneath human skin...
summary: ALYSSA is an adventure horror game, in which you play as a little girl who wakes up in an unfamiliar place… Or rather, she’s awakened by Emily, who has a… strange mask permanently attached to her head. Armed with nothing but a small lighter, Alyssa must attempt to escape from this cursed place. Meanwhile, her tormentors lurk in the shadows, waiting for a single wrong move…
